Reproduce required red workflows; fix root causes, dependencies, Pages size and certification
Prove chat, orchestration, tool permissions, recovery, mobile and deliverable output
Verify license, consent, provenance, privacy and holdout separation
Discover canonical bots, workflows, tools, functions, libraries, generators and models

milestones.goal: Reverified P0 closure and required CI stabilization
Buddy Core release candidate with E2E receipts

selection_rules: Prefer code/tool repair over model training when failure is deterministic
No training without authorized datasets, compute budget and owner approval
Compare identical pinned tasks and scorers with heldout isolation
Require positive independent improvement and no critical regression before promotion
trigger_conditions: Independent benchmark score below approved threshold
Regression on a previously certified capability
New authorized source or model revision requires retest
User-approved capability gap with concrete acceptance test

daily_schedule.daily: static inventory, security/dependency checks, smoke tests, gap queue and low-cost benchmarks
daily_schedule.monthly: load, disaster recovery, security and production recertification
